unmapped: K arms, each with a context x_t(a) in [0,1]^m drawn i.i.d. per round (tuple of contexts, rewards and consumption vectors i.i.d. from unknown D)
Reward r_t(a) in [0,1] and consumption vector v_t(a) in [0,1]^{d_res}; E[r|x]=mu_*^T x, E[v|x]=W_*^T x with mu_* in [0,1]^m, W_* in [0,1]^{m x d_res}
Budget B for each of d_res resources, given to the algorithm as input; no-op arm available; algorithm stops when budget exhausted
Regret measured against OPT, the value of the optimal static context-dependent policy satisfying constraints in expectation (upper bounds optimal adaptive policy)
settings.definition_quote: There are $K$ ``arms"... The algorithm is initially given as input a budget $B \in \mathbb{R}_+$. In every round $t$, the algorithm first observes context ${\cxL}_t(a) \in [0,1]^{m}$ for every arm $a$, and then chooses an arm $a_t \in [K]$, and finally observes a reward $r_t(a_t) \in [0,1]$ and a $d$-dimensional consumption vector $\cv_t(a_t) \in [0,1]^d$... $\Ex[r_t(a)|x_t(a), H_{t-1}] = \mu_*^\top x_t(a), \Ex[\cv_t(a)|x_t(a), H_{t-1}] = W_*^\top x_t(a)$.

algorithms.name: Algorithm 1: linCBwK with given Z (optimistic ellipsoid estimates + OMD dual multipliers)
Algorithm 2: linCBwK with Z computation (exploration phase of T_0 rounds then Algorithm 1)

source.label: th:general
source.quote: There is an algorithm for \linCBwK such that if $B>m T^{3/4}$, then with probability at least $1-\delta,$ \[ \regret(T) = O\left( (\tfrac \OPT B + 1){m} \sqrt{{\ln(\di T/\delta) \ln(T)}{T}} \right).\]

results.notes: Paper's m (context dimension) mapped to canonical d; paper's d (number of resources) renamed d_res. Regret is OPT minus realized reward. Compute: paper argues algorithm avoids NP-hard oracle; polynomial implied.

conditions: Algorithm is given Z with OPT/B <= Z <= O(OPT/B + 1) (Assumption 1)

source.label: th:coreAlgo
source.quote: Given a $Z$ as per Assumption \ref{assum:Z}, Algorithm \ref{algo:coreAlgo} achieves the following bounds, given that $\regOCO(T)$ is the regret of the \OCO algorithm, with probability $1-\delta$: $$ \regret(T) \le O\left( (\tfrac \OPT B + 1) m \sqrt{T \ln(\di T/\delta) \ln(T)} \right).$$

results.notes: Requires knowledge of Z (approximately OPT/B), not in vocabulary; recorded as condition.

tuning: twice the Z given by Corollary 4

source.label: th:largeK
source.quote: Using Algorithm \ref{algo:linearZ} with $T_0$ such that $B> \max\{2T_0, mT/\sqrt{T_0}\}$, and twice the $Z$ given by Corollary \ref{cor:packingZest}, we get a high probability regret bound of \[\tilde{O}\left(\left(\frac{\OPT}{B} +1\right) \left({T_0} + {m}{\sqrt{T}}\right)\right).\]

results.notes: T_0 is an algorithm parameter appearing in the bound.

tuning: twice the Z given by Corollary 4

source.label: th:largeK
source.quote: In particular, using $T_0= \sqrt{T}$, and assuming $B>m T^{3/4}$ gives a regret bound of \[\tilde{O}\left(\left(\frac{\OPT}{B} +1\right) {m}{\sqrt{T}}\right).\]

results.notes: Second part of Theorem 4; Õ version of Theorem 1.
